terms.comment: Our description, a bicycle without pedals: Traupman and Morgan–Owens have no word for a balance bike. Birota and pedāle are Traupman’s words for the bicycle and its pedal (pp. 215, 279).

phrases.latin: Theodōrus birotam suam, parvam, sine pedālibus, quam pedibus pellit
phrases.english: Theo’s little balance bike, with no pedals, which he pushes along with his feet

sources: Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 215, 279.
